text:
The document-body record's anatomy styles the content with the bridge styles `lede` and `body` (and the AC repeats heading-1/lede/body), but DocumentBody takes only `title`, `children` and `maxWidth`, so the record does not say which part of the children is `lede`. The code before this window used `body` only. Assumed the host's own `.prose-spec p.lede` convention: the content is `body`, and a paragraph the consumer marks `

` takes the `lede` style (font `--font-heading`, size `--text-lede`, weight `--weight-lede`, italic), via a rule scoped to the DocumentBody content. Needs: the record to say how `lede` is selected (a marked paragraph, the first paragraph, or a prop).
